name: How can I budget effectively for a home addition?

mainEntity.name: How can I budget effectively for a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective budgeting for a home addition involves defining your project scope, researching local material costs, and getting detailed estimates from contractors. It is advisable to allocate an additional 10-20% of your budget for unforeseen expenses. During the preparation phase, gathering examples of desired finishes and fixtures can help refine the initial estimates and ensure a more accurate budget projection.
